For an Indian family visiting Europe, I’d shortlist:

TATA AIG Schengen Travel Insurance — Plans from ~₹22.5/day; medical cover up to US$1M, plus trip cancellation/curtailment, baggage and passport protection. Family plans can get up to 10% discount. 
Tata AIG
+1

HDFC ERGO Schengen Travel Insurance — Strong trip-disruption coverage, including cancellation of non-refundable accommodation/activities, medical evacuation, dental and flight disruption. 
HDFC ERGO
+1

ICICI Lombard International Travel Insurance — Covers medical emergencies, trip cancellation/curtailment, and specifically visa-rejection cancellation, plus baggage and missed connections. 
ICICI Lombard

What to compare before buying: medical limit (minimum €30,000 for Schengen), cancellation reasons/limits, pre-existing-condition exclusions, deductibles, and senior-citizen coverage.
